comment: A computer player's Lurker burrows by its AI and fires at the human player's Marines in a line: Subterranean Spines fly to the maximum range (InitializeBullet 0x409d70 behaviour 9) and hit each Marine once per shot (LurkerLineHitCallback 0x409770 with the hit history of AdvanceHitHistorySlot 0x40a880).
